data.title: Tree felling permit refused
data.summary: The Bezirksamt Musterbek (Hamburg) rejected your application of 16 March 2026 to fell a copper beech at Eppendorfer Stieg 7. The decision is dated 30 April 2026 and can be challenged by objection.
data.explanation: The district office refused permission to fell the beech tree because it is protected under the Tree Protection Ordinance (Baumschutzverordnung), healthy and stable. Balcony shade is not considered an unreasonable burden. You may decide whether to file an objection (Widerspruch) with the Bezirksamt, in writing, electronically or recorded in person. The app shows until when you can do this. If you do nothing, the refusal becomes final and you may not fell the tree. Consider getting advice if you want to contest it.
